PYPL.summary: Mastercard is expanding its stablecoin capabilities by partnering with SoFi to settle debit and credit card transactions using SoFiUSD on its network. The partnership positions Mastercard to strengthen its role in connecting traditional finance with digital assets, while also exploring cross-border payments and remittances. Competitors Visa and PayPal are similarly expanding their stablecoin platforms.

PYPL.title: SoFi Brings SoFiUSD to Mastercard: Can It Unlock a New Growth Engine?
PYPL.summary: SoFi Technologies is integrating its SoFiUSD stablecoin into its debit and credit card program through Mastercard, expected to process over $25 billion in annualized volume. The move capitalizes on accelerating card activity, with Q2 2026 showing $28 billion in annualized card spend and 67% year-over-year growth in interchange fee revenues. SoFiUSD settlement could enhance fee-based revenues and support merchant payments, positioning SoFi beyond its traditional lending business.

SNPS.title: Alchip collaborates with Synopsys to Address Scale Up and Out Bandwidth Constraints
SNPS.summary: Alchip Technologies and Synopsys presented a collaborative technical solution at TSMC's 2026 OIP Ecosystem Forum addressing bandwidth limitations in AI data center ASICs. Their protocol-agnostic physical design approach leverages Synopsys' 224G PHY IP and Alchip's packaging expertise to overcome die-edge congestion, signal integrity challenges, and achieve near-theoretical bandwidth density limits, with potential scalability to 448G SerDes implementations.

CNI.summary: Canadian National Railway (CNI) successfully shipped its first unit train from Total Grain Marketing's expanded grain elevator in Lis, Illinois on September 16, 2026. VSAT.title: Viasat Wins First Task Order Award as part of $307 Million Ceiling U.S. Marine Corps Enterprise Services Contract for Multi-Orbit Connectivity
VSAT.summary: Viasat Inc. has been awarded an initial $42 million task order under a seven-year, up to $307 million IDIQ contract to provide fully managed, end-to-end global satellite services for the United States Marine Corps. The contract covers multi-orbit connectivity across L-, Ku, and Ka-bands, including access to Viasat's next-generation ViaSat-3 satellites, with 24x7x365 network and security operations support.

HPQ.title: Magnite Named Primary Video Ad Server and a Programmatic Technology Provider for HP TV+

The partnership enables advertisers to access programmatic demand across HP TV+ inventory and leverage audience intelligence through Magnite's ClearLine Curation, which offers nearly 100 pre-built audience segments or custom segments based on PC behavior data.

ORKA.title: Oruka Therapeutics Announces Positive Week 28 Data for ORKA-001 from the Ongoing EVERLAST-A Trial Showing Deepening of Responses Without Additional Dosing
ORKA.summary: Oruka Therapeutics reported positive Week 28 interim data from its EVERLAST-A Phase 2a trial of ORKA-001, an IL-23p19 monoclonal antibody for plaque psoriasis. The drug demonstrated deepening clinical responses with 71.4% of patients achieving PASI 100 (complete skin clearance) and 87.3% achieving PASI 90, six months after the last dose with no additional dosing beyond Week 4. The drug maintained a favorable safety profile consistent with the IL-23 class. Full 52-week data is expected in December 2026.
